underlying_release: flow-php/pg-query-ext 0.48.0 (pg_query.so) with libpg_query 18.0.0 linked statically, source-built for both the coverage image and the AFL++ overlay
coverage_limit: One run records two line-coverage sources for the documented sql_parse() call and the summary walk: Xdebug 3.5.3 executed lines in flow-php/postgresql PHP source (Parser, ParsedQuery, the AST Traverser and the protoc-generated Protobuf\AST classes; the Xdebug pseudo-line past the end of each first-loaded class file is removed; google/protobuf runtime lines are recorded separately and not counted) and Clang/LLVM source coverage of pg-query-ext ext/pg_query.c and libpg_query 18.0.0 in pg_query.so. Package PHP lines include the Traverser walk that the harness drives with its own NodeVisitor. AFL++ feedback comes from the native overlay: ext/pg_query.c (pg_query_parse_protobuf) plus libpg_query src_backend_parser_gram.c, src_backend_parser_scan.c and src_backend_parser_parser.c, instrumented through an allowlist while the parse-only fuzz target also runs the PHP protobuf decode; the interpreted package and google/protobuf code add no AFL++ tuples. Their parse-time package lines are recorded per control by the overlay's Xdebug trace as parser source features. Replay is per case.
coverage: Xdebug executed line coverage in flow-php/postgresql 0.48.0 PHP source plus Clang/LLVM source coverage of pg-query-ext 0.48.0 ext/pg_query.c and source-built libpg_query 18.0.0 during sql_parse() and the Traverser summary on a valid control; AFL++ feedback comes from the allowlisted ext/pg_query.c and libpg_query gram.c/scan.c/parser.c in the native overlay, with the package's parse-time PHP lines traced as features
dialect: PostgreSQL 18 grammar (libpg_query 18.0.0 through pg-query-ext; no dialect option)
parser_family: PostgreSQL grammar: libpg_query 18.0.0 through the pg-query-ext extension (shared with the flow-php/pg-query-ext and C libpg_query paths); the package adds a protobuf AST layer (protoc-generated classes decoded with google/protobuf) and a descriptor-driven Traverser
api: Flow\PostgreSql\DSL\sql_parse(string $sql): ParsedQuery (Parser::parse: pg_query_parse_protobuf, then ParseResult::mergeFromString); ParsedQuery::traverse(NodeVisitor ...) and raw(): ParseResult
scope: SQL text from local bytes passed to the documented sql_parse(), which returns a ParsedQuery over the package's Protobuf\AST\ParseResult. The harness runs the package Traverser with its own NodeVisitor registered for SelectStmt, InsertStmt, RangeVar, JoinExpr, FuncCall and A_Const, and reads targetList, whereClause, groupClause, sortClause, relation, cols and valuesLists through the generated getters. One statement per control.
observable_limits: The package requires the pg_query extension (here the pinned pg-query-ext build) and decodes with the pure-PHP google/protobuf runtime (no protobuf C extension). PHP is built with --disable-all plus ctype, which google/protobuf needs; the client, query builder, migrations, schema, deparse, fingerprint and extractor DSL functions are not exercised, nor is malformed input.
